title: Preparation of the Adenylated Oligonucleotide for Mapping 3′OH RNA Termini
author: Matus Valach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xspfndn
materials: The adenylated oligo can be directly used for RNA ligation with T4 RNA ligase 2 (optimally with T4 RNA Ligase 2, truncated KQ ( NEB #M0373)).

steps.title: Prepare Adenylated Oligonucleotide Mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the specified components to a total volume of 20 μL.

steps.title: Incubate Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 60 minutes at 65 °C.

steps.title: Inactivate Enzyme
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction for 5 minutes at 85 °C to inactivate the enzyme.
